quote.text: How often do home systems actually need servicing

promise.text: Home maintenance schedule: set real service dates

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "home"

lines.text: Build a service schedule from your actual equipment, last confirmed work and local conditions, separating monthly checks from seasonal and specialist jobs.

items.text: List heating, cooling, hot water, alarms, drainage and the appliances actually present.
Find the brand, model and correct manual.
Recover the last service report and record its actual scope.
Copy each required inspection, cleaning, test or replacement into a separate task with its source.
Put seasonal work before the local weather or usage period that matters.
Book unknown or concerning systems for assessment, then use the findings to set the next action.

line.text: A hand-built schedule for 122 kinds of thing found in homes, including the jobs that belong to a month rather than a timer.
